name: Shilpa Shinde-Garg
office: La Cañada Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Shilpa Shinde-Garg is a physician. She has practiced hospital medicine for 18 years and previously taught in the Los Angeles Unified School District. She has led foundations for boys' football and girls' flag football, and served on the stadium turf advisory committee. She served as the visibility lead for the Measure LCF campaign.

sentences.text: She has practiced hospital medicine for 18 years and previously taught in the Los Angeles Unified School District.
She has led foundations for boys' football and girls' flag football, and served on the stadium turf advisory committee.
She served as the visibility lead for the Measure LCF campaign.

items.text: At an October 2026 candidate forum, she supported continuing the district's strict anti-bullying policy. Her campaign says she is committed to academic excellence, fiscal responsibility, student well-being, and strong partnerships with teachers and families. In a questionnaire, she prioritized transparency around infrastructure improvements, thoughtful technology integration, and support for extracurricular programs. She says she will advocate for competitive teacher pay and manageable class sizes.
